main_findings: No fatal algebraic error was identified in the refreshing-HMM proof chain during source audit.
Most foundational theorems are classical, elementary, or careful repackagings.
The refreshing-HMM memory law is mathematically coherent but too special and incremental for the requested venue level.
A1 v37 already supplies a more general anisotropic attainable-geometry-to-causal-memory transfer theorem; GTF-I mainly adds a strongly contracting time-uniform instance.
GTF-I improves typing and scope discipline but does not close the load-bearing eleven-paper model-specific dependency gaps.
The singular-statistical G2 side remains an interface; A2 v112 contains deeper model-specific experiment-comparison results than the current abstraction.
A top-four reconsideration would require a genuinely general G1/G3 theorem, a matched G2 singular-statistical theorem, or closure of a major legacy model-specific gate.
